rationale: Round 2 produced substantive new commitments (disclosed €4bn gap figure, jointly-verified methodology, a concrete top-level contribution number, and movement on guarantee horizon/triggers), but the actual test of adequacy—running the labour package against the €4bn figure—has not yet been done, and the core disagreement over closures-as-fallback vs. unconditional no-closures remains unresolved. Since positions are still actively moving and the decisive arithmetic is still pending, further rounds are likely to change the substantive picture.
